title: I Am Already Here
description: A man in a dark trench coat stands on ornate stone steps in a flooded gothic hall, reaching toward a swirling vortex of glowing pink tentacles, hands, and computer monitors emerging from the water. The flooded floor contains lily pads, floating papers, old CRT monitors displaying 'I AM ALREADY HERE', and several large fish swimming through the scene.
prompt: A surreal scene in a flooded gothic hall with arched windows and ornate stone steps. A man in a long dark trench coat stands in the foreground reaching toward a swirling vortex of glowing pink energy tentacles, disembodied hands, and old CRT computer monitors. The water is filled with lily pads, swimming fish, and floating papers. One large monitor in the water displays the text 'I AM ALREADY HERE'. Moody atmospheric lighting with pink and purple tones.
